description: Land Aquisition - Divisional Secretariat - Valikamam South West- Sandilipay, Valikamam South West D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act for the construction of a MOH Office. It contains detailed land descriptions (location, cadastral details, extent), specifies the purpose of acquisition, and outlines compensation procedures for interested parties. This fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition for public purposes.
